description: Defines data models and related methods for managing threads and thread memberships in a messaging application, including structures for thread metadata, responses, options, and user-thread relationships.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Represents metadata for a thread, including root post ID, channel ID, reply count, last reply timestamp, participants, deletion timestamp, and team ID.

classes.name: ThreadResponse
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a thread, including participants, post content, reply counts, and urgency status.

classes.name: Threads
classes.description: Container for multiple ThreadResponse objects along with total counts and unread metrics.

classes.name: GetUserThreadsOpts
classes.description: Options for fetching user-specific thread lists with filters like pagination, unread status, and team scope.

classes.name: ThreadMembership
classes.description: Models a user's membership in a thread, including follow status, last update/view timestamps, and mention counts.

classes.name: ThreadMembershipForExport
classes.description: Simplified export structure for thread membership data, including username, last viewed timestamp, and unread mentions.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an ETag string based on post ID and last reply timestamp.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the thread membership's post ID and user ID.
